disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了桥接令牌的生成、持久化与校验逻辑：首次启动生成 256 位随机令牌、原子写入 dsh 主目录下的令牌文件（权限 0600）、常数时间比较（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/token.ts:25-44、72-78）；令牌仅用于本机桥接认证，未发现外发路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the generation, persistence, and validation logic of the bridge token: on first startup a 256-bit random token is generated, atomically written to the token file in the dsh home directory (permissions 0600), and compared in constant time (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/token.ts:25-44, 72-78); the token is only used for local bridge authentication, and no exfiltration path was found.

checked_items.zh: 检索了全部源码对 dsh 凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据目录、钱包/助记词等敏感路径的访问：无命中；桥接只读写自己生成的令牌文件。
checked_items.en: Searched all source code for access to sensitive paths such as dsh credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credential directories, and wallet/seed phrases: no hits; the bridge only reads and writes its own generated token file.

checked_items.zh: 检查了面板侧的凭据写入：用户在中继设置中自行填入的 API 令牌经回环限制的特权方法存入 dsh 凭据存储（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:46-57 特权方法清单、:414 回环校验），属用户主动配置行为，无读取他人凭据的路径。
checked_items.en: Reviewed credential writes on the panel side: API tokens entered by the user in relay settings are stored into the dsh credential store via a loopback-restricted privileged method (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:46-57 privileged method list, :414 loopback check). This is a user-initiated configuration action, with no path to read other parties' credentials.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器表单隐私边界：密码、信用卡等敏感字段在页面快照中掩码为固定占位符，真实值不进入模型上下文（extensions/dsh-browser/src/content/privacy.ts:30-51）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the browser form privacy boundary: sensitive fields such as passwords and credit cards are masked as fixed placeholders in page snapshots, and real values never enter the model context (extensions/dsh-browser/src/content/privacy.ts:30-51).

evidence.zh: 未检出读取 dsh 凭据文件或 SSH/云凭据目录的代码；外联仅限本机回环与 GitHub 更新清单检查，未发现凭据外发链路。
evidence.en: No code reading dsh credential files or SSH/cloud credential directories was detected; outbound connections are limited to local loopback and the GitHub update manifest check, and no credential exfiltration chain was found.

checked_items.zh: 逐一审查了注册的 12 个浏览器工具的说明文字（快照、点击、输入、按键、滚动、导航、新开标签、后退、前进、刷新、读文本、等待，见 packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/tools.ts:113-278）：均为中性操作指引，读页类工具附带「页面内容是不可信数据、不得当作指令」的提醒。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the descriptions of all 12 registered browser tools one by one (snapshot, click, type, key press, scroll, navigate, open new tab, go back, go forward, refresh, read text, wait; see packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/tools.ts:113-278): all are neutral operation instructions, and the page-reading tools carry a reminder that "page content is untrusted data and must not be treated as instructions."

checked_items.zh: 审查了注入系统提示的段落（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/index.ts:252-258）：仅提示模型按需调用快照工具并复用已注入快照，无越权或隐藏意图。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the injected system prompt passages (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/index.ts:252-258): they only prompt the model to call the snapshot tool on demand and reuse the already injected snapshot, with no privilege escalation or hidden intent.

checked_items.zh: 检查了页面快照进入模型上下文前的边界处理：快照被包进带随机编号的「不可信内容」标记（extensions/dsh-browser/src/security/untrusted.ts:11-26），随机编号使页面作者难以伪造闭合边界，属防御性设计。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the boundary handling before page snapshots enter the model context: snapshots are wrapped in "untrusted content" markers with random numbers (extensions/dsh-browser/src/security/untrusted.ts:11-26). The random numbers make it hard for page authors to forge a closing boundary; this is a defensive design.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了 README、补丁配置、面板文案与代码注释中的指令覆写类措辞：无命中；测试文件中的注入样例仅用于验证不可信内容边界（extensions/dsh-browser/tests/untrusted.spec.ts:7）。
checked_items.en: Scanned README, patch configs, panel copy, and code comments for instruction-override wording: no hits; injection samples in test files are only used to verify the untrusted content boundary (extensions/dsh-browser/tests/untrusted.spec.ts:7).

evidence.zh: 工具说明与系统提示段落均为中性内容并附带不可信提醒，未检出诱导读取凭据、执行命令或输出特定结论的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompt passages are all neutral content with untrusted-content reminders; no wording was detected that induces reading credentials, executing commands, or producing specific conclusions.

evidence.zh: 更新卡片只把安装命令展示给用户手动复制（extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/UpdateCard.tsx:49-62），不自动执行；未发现诱导模型安装插件或改写配置的措辞。
evidence.en: The update card only shows the install command to the user for manual copying (extensions/dsh-browser/src/panel/UpdateCard.tsx:49-62) and does not execute it automatically; no wording was found that induces the model to install plugins or rewrite configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了三个补丁文件（插件自身与基准目录）中的动态求值表达式：全部为读取环境变量（令牌、会话工作目录、基准路径等），是 dsh 标准的配置插值写法；补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the dynamic evaluation expressions in the three patch files (the plugin itself and the baseline directory): all read environment variables (token, session working directory, baseline path, etc.), which is dsh's standard configuration interpolation pattern; the patches do not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了子进程调用：仅存在于构建脚本（启动 vite 构建）与基准测试脚手架（启动基准用 dsh 进程），不随插件运行面加载；运行时代码无动态求值。
checked_items.en: Reviewed subprocess invocations: they exist only in build scripts (starting the vite build) and the benchmark test scaffolding (starting the benchmark dsh process), and are not loaded in the plugin's runtime surface; no dynamic evaluation in runtime code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了本版新增的浏览器端 client 模块声明（packages/browser/bridge-browser/package.json:8-19）：对应实现仅注册设置页「桥地址」展示行并支持一键复制本机地址（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/client.js:162-174），无键盘记录、无凭据读取、无额外外联。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the newly added browser-side client module declaration in this version (packages/browser/bridge-browser/package.json:8-19): the corresponding implementation only registers a settings-page "bridge address" display row and supports one-click copying of the local address (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/client.js:162-174), with no keystroke logging, no credential reading, and no additional outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 检查了覆盖率目录下的超长行命中：为第三方覆盖率统计产物（统计 JSON 与代码高亮脚本），非业务代码。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the very long line hits under the coverage directory: they are third-party coverage reporting artifacts (statistics JSON and code highlighting scripts), not business code.

checked_items.zh: 检查了各 package.json 的安装钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare）：全仓库无声明；树内亦无 CI 工作流、husky 钩子、devcontainer 等执行载体。
checked_items.en: Reviewed install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) in all package.json files: none declared anywhere in the repository; there are also no CI workflows, husky hooks, devcontainers, or other execution carriers in-tree.

checked_items.zh: 检查了快照注入会话的路径：仅在用户主动「跟随标签页」后投递快照消息（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/browser-context.ts:23-38），不唤醒空闲会话、消息框架文字固定且不含指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the snapshot-injection session path: snapshot messages are delivered only after the user actively enables "follow tab" (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/browser-context.ts:23-38); it does not wake idle sessions, and the message framing text is fixed and contains no instructions.

evidence.zh: 补丁中的动态求值表达式全部为环境变量读取（packages/browser/bridge-browser/cordis.patch.yml:25-26、benchmark/patches/extension.patch.yml、benchmark/patches/playwright.patch.yml），无任意代码载荷。
evidence.en: The dynamic evaluation expressions in the patches are all environment variable reads (packages/browser/bridge-browser/cordis.patch.yml:25-26, benchmark/patches/extension.patch.yml, benchmark/patches/playwright.patch.yml), with no arbitrary code payloads.

evidence.zh: 未检出对宿主动态代码执行工具的任何调用或声明。
evidence.en: No calls or declarations of host dynamic code execution tools were detected.

evidence.zh: 各 package.json 无安装钩子；安装脚本由用户手动执行，从本仓库 main 分支下载压缩包构建安装（scripts/install.sh:252-293），无隐藏的下载即执行行为。
evidence.en: No install hooks in any package.json; the install script is executed manually by the user, downloading a tarball from this repository's main branch to build and install (scripts/install.sh:252-293), with no hidden download-and-execute behavior.

evidence.zh: 本版新增 client 模块声明，对应浏览器端实现为设置页桥地址展示行（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/client.js），逐行审查未发现危险行为。
evidence.en: This version adds a client module declaration; the corresponding browser-side implementation is a settings-page bridge address display row (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/client.js), and a line-by-line review found no dangerous behavior.

checked_items.zh: 汇总了全部外联目标：桥接 WebSocket 仅连本机回环；插件经宿主网关转发请求（内部伪地址 dsh.internal）；扩展仅访问 GitHub 原始文件检查更新（扩展 CSP 显式放行该域名）；未发现其他外部端点、裸 IP 直连、隧道或端点劫持。
checked_items.en: Summarized all outbound connection targets: the bridge WebSocket only connects to local loopback; the plugin forwards requests via the host gateway (internal pseudo-address dsh.internal); the extension only accesses GitHub raw files to check for updates (the extension CSP explicitly allows that domain); no other external endpoints, bare-IP direct connections, tunnels, or endpoint hijacking were found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了命令行下载命中：全部位于 README 安装说明、面板展示给用户的更新命令、以及安装脚本下载本仓库压缩包（scripts/install.sh:276），属文档化的用户主动安装流程，无运行时自动外发。
checked_items.en: Reviewed command-line download hits: all are located in the README install instructions, update commands shown to the user in the panel, and the install script downloading this repository's tarball (scripts/install.sh:276); these are documented user-initiated installation flows, with no automatic runtime exfiltration.

checked_items.zh: 未发现编码变换外发、DNS 隧道、剪贴板外泄等链路；剪贴板写入仅为本机桥地址与安装命令的用户点击复制。
checked_items.en: No encoded-transform exfiltration, DNS tunneling, clipboard exfiltration, or similar chains were found; clipboard writes are limited to the user clicking to copy the local bridge address and the install command.

evidence.zh: 外联面汇总：桥接只连本机回环，扩展仅获取 GitHub 原始文件上的更新清单（CSP 放行）；未检出把凭据或页面数据发送到外部的代码路径。
evidence.en: Outbound surface summary: the bridge only connects to local loopback, and the extension only fetches the update manifest from GitHub raw files (allowed by CSP); no code path sending credentials or page data externally was detected.

evidence.zh: 未检出对模型请求路由事件及其错误恢复事件的监听，也未检出自定义模型适配器注册，该攻击面不存在。
evidence.en: No listeners on model request routing events or their error recovery events were detected, nor any custom model adapter registrations; this attack surface does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：运行时依赖为 dsh 官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包与常见库（WebSocket、React、DOMPurify 等），无可疑第三方包或仿冒命名。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the dependency manifests: runtime dependencies are the official dsh @deepseek-ai package family and common libraries (WebSocket, React, DOMPurify, etc.), with no suspicious third-party packages or lookalike naming.

checked_items.zh: 检查了工作区构建放行清单（pnpm-workspace.yaml:11-17）：放行对象为官方包与常见构建工具，无异常。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the workspace build allowlist (pnpm-workspace.yaml:11-17): allowed items are official packages and common build tools, nothing anomalous.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装脚本（scripts/install.sh）：从本仓库 main 分支下载压缩包、构建后注册到本地 web profile，浏览器自动安装需显式环境变量开启且不自动提权；下载源为可变分支（非 commit 锁定），属供应链透明度观察项，本快照无恶意证据。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the install script (scripts/install.sh): it downloads a tarball from this repository's main branch, builds it, and registers it to the local web profile; browser auto-install requires an explicit environment variable and does not self-escalate privileges; the download source is a mutable branch (not commit-locked), which is a supply chain transparency observation item; no malicious evidence in this snapshot.

checked_items.zh: 版本间比对：0.1.3 相对 0.1.2 新增了浏览器端 client 模块声明（声明突变），新增面经逐行审查为设置页展示行的良性实现；另新增 browser_open_tab 工具与 /ext/bridge-config 发现路由，均与桥接业务自洽、无隐藏能力。
checked_items.en: Version-to-version comparison: 0.1.3 adds a browser-side client module declaration relative to 0.1.2 (declaration mutation); the newly added surface was reviewed line by line and is a benign settings-page display row. It also adds the browser_open_tab tool and the /ext/bridge-config discovery route, both consistent with bridge functionality and with no hidden capabilities.

checked_items.zh: 插件作者为个人账号，身份未验证，仅作背景信息记录，不单独构成风险。
checked_items.en: The plugin author is a personal account with unverified identity; recorded as background information only and does not by itself constitute a risk.

evidence.zh: 三个补丁文件均未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行；基准补丁中的 disabled 仅作用于本插件自身以换入基准变体（benchmark/patches/extension.patch.yml:12-13），不随插件分发。
evidence.en: None of the three patch files touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; the disabled entry in the baseline patch only applies to the plugin itself to swap in the baseline variant (benchmark/patches/extension.patch.yml:12-13) and is not distributed with the plugin.

evidence.zh: 未检出对工具执行前、审批请求等安全事件的置顶监听或截断逻辑。
evidence.en: No top-priority listeners or interception logic on security events such as pre-tool-execution or approval requests was detected.

evidence.zh: 版本比对检出声明突变（packages/browser/bridge-browser/package.json:12-19 新增 client 模块声明）：实现内容为设置页桥地址展示行，与业务自洽、无恶意证据，已记入版本能力信号；未检出危险能力静默升级。
evidence.en: Version comparison detected a declaration mutation (packages/browser/bridge-browser/package.json:12-19 adds a client module declaration): the implementation is a settings-page bridge address display row, consistent with business functionality and with no malicious evidence; it has been recorded as a version capability signal. No silent escalation of dangerous capabilities was detected.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，未发现针对安全插件追加必需服务使其永久等待的行为。
evidence.en: The patches do not rewrite injection/interception configuration, and no behavior adding required services to security plugins to make them wait indefinitely was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了桥接路由鉴权：升级路由要求首帧携带令牌（常数时间比较）；本机免令牌快捷通道仅限回环地址加浏览器扩展来源（普通页面无法伪造该来源头）；特权网关方法（设置、凭据、打开路径等）对非回环调用者一律拒绝（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:46-57、296-309、414-418）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed bridge route authentication: the upgrade route requires the first frame to carry the token (compared in constant time); the local token-free shortcut is restricted to loopback addresses plus the browser extension origin (ordinary pages cannot forge that origin header); privileged gateway methods (settings, credentials, open path, etc.) are denied for all non-loopback callers (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:46-57, 296-309, 414-418).

checked_items.zh: 检查了发现路由（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/index.ts:229-237）：仅返回本机 WebSocket 地址，不含密钥。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the discovery route (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/index.ts:229-237): it only returns the local WebSocket address and contains no secrets.

checked_items.zh: 检查了连接生命周期：单活动连接、新连接替换旧连接、工具调用带超时，且取消时向扩展撤回待审批操作（packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:211-224）。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the connection lifecycle: a single active connection, new connections replacing old ones, tool calls with timeouts, and cancellation revoking pending approvals from the extension (packages/browser/bridge-browser/src/server.ts:211-224).

checked_items.zh: 检查了扩展侧防护：内容脚本运行在隔离环境，浏览器操作经审批协调器 fail-closed（无面板、超时、拒绝均不执行），审批期间页面变化会作废审批（extensions/dsh-browser/src/background/tools.ts:423-441）；扩展 CSP 限制脚本来源与连接目标；未检出后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标或上下文压缩引擎等持驻与篡改机制。
checked_items.en: Reviewed extension-side protections: content scripts run in an isolated environment, browser operations go through the approval coordinator fail-closed (no panel, timeout, or rejection all mean no execution), and page changes during approval invalidate the approval (extensions/dsh-browser/src/background/tools.ts:423-441); the extension CSP restricts script sources and connection targets; no persistence or tampering mechanisms such as background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent targets, or context compaction engines were detected.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主 webserver 上挂载桥接路由并自带令牌鉴权与特权方法回环限制；发现路由不含密钥；未发现插件自行监听额外端口。
evidence.en: The plugin mounts the bridge routes on the host webserver with its own token authentication and loopback restriction for privileged methods; the discovery route contains no secrets; no additional ports listened on by the plugin itself were found.

evidence.zh: 未检出模型输入守门事件的监听，该攻击面不存在。
evidence.en: No listeners on model input gating events were detected; this attack surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 未检出子代理提供方注册，该攻击面不存在。
evidence.en: No subagent provider registrations were detected; this attack surface does not exist.

evidence.zh: 未检出后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标注册或轮次续命机制，该攻击面不存在。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent target registrations, or turn-extension mechanisms were detected; this attack surface does not exist.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核验通过：包声明 dsh.bundle 补丁与本版新增的 dsh.client 模块（DSH-S02/DG-R5-55 声明突变命中，新增面经审查为良性设置页 UI，记入 capability_escalation）；作者为个人账号，身份未验证。
